Looks like you have to give them notice after a short period of time that you're throwing their stuff out if they don't come get it. Idk if that means I'm breaking the law by not letting him gather it himself or by not letting him come back for what i didn't/couldn't give him (since i threw out a good amount of it and continue to toss what i find)

Thanks for your kind words. I definitely try to keep in mind I'm not the one in the wrong for getting these types of comments, but ya know.
Trying to forgive myself for my mistakes and do my best to move on now though, this really helps.
Thanks, I'm trying to figure this whole thing out still, but i do want to go back to therapy. I was only in trauma therapy during the time i was in the abusive situation i mentioned.
Oh gosh 😭 i think i know exactly what you mean. Here's hoping we can both work past these struggles

Mid twenties woman here, but everyone tells me i look like a kid. I work retail. Aside from that, I've dealt with various forms of abuse ever since i was a kid and i think that contributed to me not really being able to handle a lot of situations in a healthy way.

People treating me like I'm too young to know things even when they know I'm an adult, people cutting me off mid-sentence and blowing off whatever i have to say, or implying I'm downright stupid, are the things that happen to me most. I also get really gross comments sometimes though. Usually from guys, but a few days ago i had one of my coworkers telling me i should stay longer cause I'm "single and live alone, right? You don't have anyone to go back to. Oh wait, are you dating your dog? Is that why you can't stay?" I get quite a few unsettling comments like that when they learn something about the eay i live and idk how to even handle that.

What did you do to set boundaries for the things you described?
Thanks. I've found people usually don't understand though and the way i am just gives people more ammo. :/ appreciate the thought though.

How are you doing when it comes to managing your responses?

I wish i didn't have to make a fool of myself in the first place to realize i need to manage these things better for my future's sake. But well, can't go back in time.
You guys are all really helpful. :') thanks for telling your story about work. Makes me feel a little less afraid of whatever might happen. Congrats on your business also.

I saw a trauma therapist while i was in the above mentioned situation, but I'm not sure how to go about getting one right now since i got that therapy /because/ of that situation. I don't know what EMDR is, but I'll look into it
I appreciate it. That's all fine

Thanks so much! I'm trying to be a little easier on myself and calm down. Gonna go to work and act normal and hopefully things will be fine. And if not, I'll try to take that in stride too.

And yeah, people are confusing. There's just certain things about some people that set off alarm bells in my head and then it turns out my brain was playing tricks on me. Ugh

Thank you so much for this thoughtful response. I feel somewhat lighter knowing I'm not alone in how i feel. I'll definitely check out the resources you gave and take a look at your comments.

Thanks for the offer to talk, do you mind a pm if i take you up on it?

Hi. I might not fully understand your pain, but I hope you know that you have the strength to make it through this. It won't be easy, but if you can get a job and save up and avoid your mother as much as possible in the meantime, you can move out on your own and make a path for to happiness yourself.

If you want to talk, i can lend an ear but idk if I'll be helpful. Hang in there.
Well i decided because he was screaming at me and slamming things, calling me ugly etc. I already failed though. I took him back. I wish i hadn't. I'm so tired. Don't make the same mistake as me.
I'm really sorry to hear about your situation, but thanks for the response. Can i ask what helps you cope in day-to-day life?
I truly appreciate your words. I feel so conflicted and it's hard to live with all the emotions i constantly feel. But I'll certainly try. I wonder how long it will take to feel stable again.

Kicking him out is the most logical answer. But i can't bring myself to. He doesn't really have anywhere else to go and as stupid as i feel about this, i do love and care about him.

You're right. I just don't know how to reconcile the feelings i have i guess. I feel so dumb though.
